statement: A limited company must deliver a return of allotment, containing the prescribed information and accompanied by a statement of capital, to the registrar for registration within one month of making an allotment of shares.
caveat: The return reports the allotment; the directors' authority to allot and any pre-emption rights are governed by other Companies Act 2006 provisions this rule does not state. Confirm the authority to allot before issuing shares.
